opening.heading: A discovery, not yet a development

paragraphs.text: Seplat reports oil and gas at Aku-01 in onshore Imo State, with preliminary estimates and a plan for potential future production. Sources do not establish current production, revenue, exact wellhead or named host community.

Appraisal, engineering, approvals, investment, infrastructure, community governance, skills and environmental controls stand between a discovery and lived outcomes. Existing systems make several pathways plausible; none makes a specific benefit or harm inevitable.

place.heading: Imo State, at the supported resolution

paragraphs.text: OML 53 is an onshore Imo State licence with existing producing fields and infrastructure. This edition remains regional because the cited discovery evidence does not establish Aku-01's exact wellhead or an official host-community determination.

D1-S1.heading: Aku-01 changes the regional possibility set without beginning production

paragraphs.text: Aku-01 changes the regional possibility set without beginning production. Do not describe a preliminary discovery as proved reserves, production or revenue.

D1-S2.heading: Five reservoir intervals and preliminary in-place estimates define the announced scale

paragraphs.text: Five reservoir intervals and preliminary in-place estimates define the announced scale. Company preliminary estimates remain subject to appraisal and development decisions.

D1-S3.heading: The oil find was outside the original well plan, while adjacent prospects remain future exploration questions

paragraphs.text: The oil find was outside the original well plan, while adjacent prospects remain future exploration questions. De-risking is not the same as discovery or commerciality in adjacent prospects.

I1-S1.heading: OML 53 already contains producing fields, flow stations, pipelines and gas development infrastructure

paragraphs.text: OML 53 already contains producing fields, flow stations, pipelines and gas development infrastructure. Wider-block infrastructure does not locate Aku-01 or prove a final connection route.

I1-S2.heading: A planned tie-back could shorten the path to market, but engineering, approvals and timing remain unresolved

paragraphs.text: A planned tie-back could shorten the path to market, but engineering, approvals and timing remain unresolved. A stated plan is not a completed tie-back or start-up schedule.

MF1-S1.heading: Commercial value depends on recoverability, development cost, timing, partners, prices and approvals

paragraphs.text: Commercial value depends on recoverability, development cost, timing, partners, prices and approvals—not only resource size. Atlas makes no valuation, price target or investment recommendation.

MF1-S2.heading: Seplat reports a 40% operated interest; preliminary gross in-place quantities are not the company's net saleable volumes

paragraphs.text: Seplat reports a 40% operated interest; preliminary gross in-place quantities are not the company's net saleable volumes. Do not convert gross in-place estimates into company revenue or reserves.

MF1-S3.heading: Existing infrastructure can be commercially relevant, yet no Aku-01 capital budget or project economics were disclosed in the cited evidence

paragraphs.text: Existing infrastructure can be commercially relevant, yet no Aku-01 capital budget or project economics were disclosed in the cited evidence. Absence of disclosed project economics requires an explicit knowledge stop.

C1-S1.heading: Nigeria's host-community framework makes participation and development planning a governed process

paragraphs.text: Nigeria's host-community framework makes participation and development planning a governed process. Do not name a host community without an applicable official determination.

C1-S2.heading: The statutory contribution is linked to preceding-year operating expenditure, not a simple share of discovery value

paragraphs.text: The statutory contribution is linked to preceding-year operating expenditure, not a simple share of discovery value. Do not imply a windfall, fixed amount or immediate distribution.

W1-S1.heading: Imo's labour market is dominated by self-employment and informal work, so expectations may spread beyond direct payroll jobs

paragraphs.text: Imo's labour market is dominated by self-employment and informal work, so expectations may spread beyond direct payroll jobs. State survey structure does not predict Aku-01 employment.

W1-S2.heading: Oil-and-gas participation can require verified training, practical experience, certification and contractor pathways

paragraphs.text: Oil-and-gas participation can require verified training, practical experience, certification and contractor pathways. The framework creates pathways, not a guarantee for a fictional applicant.

E1-S1.heading: Environmental review and operating controls belong before any claim about local impact or safety

paragraphs.text: Environmental review and operating controls belong before any claim about local impact or safety. Do not invent a spill, pollution event, land take or safety outcome.

E1-S2.heading: Gas handling choices can affect flaring, emissions, waste and the value recovered from a development

paragraphs.text: Gas handling choices can affect flaring, emissions, waste and the value recovered from a development. General regulatory objectives do not establish Aku-01's future emissions.

E1-S3.heading: Exact wellhead, host-community and development-plan evidence remain unresolved and limit local claims

paragraphs.text: Exact wellhead, host-community and development-plan evidence remain unresolved and limit local claims. UNKNOWN is a production boundary, not an invitation to infer a site.
